event.title: Nigel Farage Wins Clacton By-Election Against Count Binface
event.canonical_title: Nigel Farage Wins Clacton By-Election Against Count Binface
event.summary: Polls have opened for a by-election in Clacton, England, featuring Nigel Farage, leader of Reform UK, against Count Binface, a candidate known for humor. The election has seen a boycott from the main political parties, leading to a unique matchup that has drawn attention due to its unconventional nature.

timeline.title: Nigel Farage Wins Clacton By-Election Against Count Binface
timeline.summary: Nigel Farage, leader of the Reform UK party, won the Clacton by-election with 63% of the vote, defeating novelty candidate Count Binface, who received 27%. The election was criticized by major parties as a stunt, and Farage reportedly skipped the vote count due to security concerns following a credible threat against him. This election was triggered by Farage's resignation from the seat a month prior.
key_facts: Nigel Farage won the Clacton by-election with 63% of the vote.
Count Binface, a novelty candidate, received 27% of the vote.
The election was criticized as a stunt by major parties.
Farage did not attend the vote count due to security concerns.
